summary: Check out the Cash Shop details for Founder's Access in Global MapleStory Classic World!
body:
Limited-Time and Rotational Sales

The following sales will only be available for a limited time, or will have their sales details periodically update over time.

A Note on Gifting

The Gift feature in the Global MapleStory Classic World Cash Shop is available for characters Lv. 12 and above. This is similar to the restriction in place in Global MapleStory, but at a lower level to reflect the different leveling speeds between the worlds.

Founder's Mystery Fashion Crate

  • UTC: Tuesday, October 6 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, October 28 7:59 AM

Available in Classic World:

  • Founder's Mystery Fashion Crate
    • Price (1): 3,500 NX
    • Price (11): 35,000 NX
    • Duration: 7 days

The Founder's Mystery Fashion Crate contains one random Equip item from the below list:

Angel Halo, Toga, Baby Angel Wings, and Angel Wand. All items are Dyeable.

Blue Bucket Hat, Tourist T, White Jeans, Black Sunglasses, and Cherub's Bow. All items are Dyeable.

Blue Cap, Orange Baseball Jacket, Ripped Jeans, and Orange Toy Hammer. All items are Dyeable.

Blue Cap, Rainbow Knit, and Ripped Jeans. All items are Dyeable.

Cat Hat, Cat Suit, Gold Kitty Slippers, Kitty Chat Ring, and White Label Ring. All items, excluding the Rings, are Dyeable.

Meshcap, Pink Allstar, and Jean Shorts. All items are Dyeable.

Bunny Ears, Orange Mushroom Balloon, Blue Watch, Red Trainer Jacket, Red Trainer Pants, and Yellow Rainbow Sneaks. All items are Dyeable.

Bunny Earmuffs, Orange Mushroom Balloon, Blue Watch, Red Trainer Jacket, Red Trainer Pants, and Yellow Rainbow Sneaks. All items are Dyeable.

Beret, Red Sailor Shirt, Red Sailor Skirt, and Black Enamel Shoes. All items are Dyeable.

Patissier Hat, Patissier Uniform, and Yellow Spatula. All items are Dyeable.

Dollish Pink, Purple Dorothy Dress, and Sailor Hat. All items are Dyeable.

Sailor Outfit. Item is Dyeable.

White Ribboned Sailor Dress. Item is Dyeable.

Slime T-Shirt, Slime Slippers, Slime Earrings, and Lined Hip-Hop Pants. All items are Dyeable.

Reggae Hat, Orange Hooded Shirt, and Butterfly Skirt. All items are Dyeable.

White Hooded Vest and Butterfly Skirt. Both items are Dyeable.

Beetle Long Sleeve and Lined Hip-Hop Pants. Both items are Dyeable.

Weapon Cover Restrictions:

  • Angel Wand, Orange Toy Hammer, and Yellow Spatula can be equipped with any weapon.
  • Cherub's Bow can only be equipped with Bow-type weapons.

See all the reward rates for this item here. MFC items obtained in the Netherlands cannot be traded outside of the account, but can be traded within the account and can be exchanged for Aurora Stamps. Players in Belgium, Slovakia, and Brazil are unable to purchase Mystery items. The full list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.

Any unwanted items can be traded to other players or exchanged for Aurora Stamps by right-clicking them prior to being equipped. Aurora Stamps can be exchanged for special items via the Aurora Stamp Shop.

Aurora Stamp Shop Season 1

  • UTC: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 13, 2027 7:59 AM

If you receive items from Mystery Fashion Crates that you do not want, you can exchange them by right-clicking them in your inventory prior to equipping them. You can receive one Aurora Stamp per item. An unwanted outfit set from the Signature Style Collection can also be exchanged for 2 Aurora Stamps prior to being opened.

  • Aurora Stamps
    • Acquired by exchanging (prior to being equipped) Mystery Fashion Crate rewards.
    • Can be traded between characters on the same account within the same world.
    • Season 1 Aurora Stamps will expire on Wednesday, January 13, 2027 at 7:59 AM UTC.

When you collect enough stamps, double-click on the stamps in your inventory to open up the Aurora Stamp Shop, where you can purchase the following items!

  • Aurora Mystery Fashion Crate
    • Price (1): 20 Aurora Stamps
    • Price (10): 200 Aurora Stamps
    • Duration: 7 days
  • Mystery Palette Exchange Coupon
    • Price: 5 Stamps
    • Duration: 14 days (resulting item has a 30-day duration)
    • Randomly changes the color of a Dyeable decoration item once.
    • Coupon is tradable, however the resulting item cannot be traded.
    • Even if used multiple times, the colors will be changed based on the item's original appearance.
    • Special effects and certain weapons will retain their original color even if a Palette is used.
    • An item must have been equipped or been otherwise made untradable for a Palette to be used on it.
    • Outfit items that can be recolored with Palettes are marked with the Aurora Badge in the item icon, indicating that it has absorbed the power of Aurora and can be dyed.
    • The list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.
  • Palette Cleanser Exchange Coupon
    • Price: 10 Stamps
    • Duration: 14 days (resulting item has a 30-day duration)
    • Reverts the color of an item dyed with a Palette (such as the Mystery Palette) once.
    • Coupon is tradable, however the resulting item cannot be traded.
    • The list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.

White Choco Bunny, Splash Choco Girl, Cacao Bear Shoes, Chocolate Ribbon, Soft Chocolate Fondue Scepter, Choco Candy Cookie, Ink-and-Wash Thought Bubble Ring, and Ink-and-Wash Painting Name Tag Ring. All items, excluding the Rings, are Dyeable.

Black Cat Beanie, Red Check Rider, Violet Dot Jeans, Blank Eye Patch, Chocolate Label Ring, and Chocolate Chat Ring. All items, excluding the Rings, are Dyeable.

Sky Blue Cat Beanie, Pink Bunny Sweater, Hearts Tights, Pink Elephant Slippers, Heartbreaker Lips, Chocolate Label Ring, and Chocolate Chat Ring. All items, excluding the Rings, are Dyeable.

Orange Cat Beanie, Loose Fit Sweater, Stocking Shorts, and Detective Glass. All items are Dyeable.

Heart Sunglasses, Loose Fit Sweater, Stocking Shorts, and Starlight Heart Scepter. All items are Dyeable.

Weapon Cover Restrictions:

  • Soft Chocolate Fondue Scepter, Detective Glass, and Starlight Heart Scepter can be equipped with any weapon.

See all the reward rates for this item here. Players in Belgium, Slovakia, and Brazil are unable to purchase Mystery items. The full list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.

Fall Store Permit

  • UTC: Tuesday, October 6 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, November 18 5:59 PM

Available in Classic World:

  • Fall Store Permit
    • Price: 3,000 NX
    • Duration: 90 days
    • This special-edition coupon allows you to open an orange tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market.
    • If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

Evergreen Sales

The following items and sales will be available until further notice.

Monthly Essentials

Available in Classic World:

  • Monthly Essentials
    • Price: 28,600 NX 9,900 NX
    • Duration: 30 days
    • Contains:
      • 20 Megaphone Exchange Coupon (30-day duration)
      • Transparent Hat (30-day duration)
      • Transparent Cape (30-day duration)
      • Transparent Shoes (30-day duration)
      • 5 Double Item Megaphone Exchange Coupon (30-day duration)
      • Special Store Permit (30-day duration)
      • Portable Storage (30-day duration)
    • Purchasable once per world, with an additional purchase being made available after 30 days.
    • Can only be purchased with NX.
    • Both the package and its contents are untradable.

Convenience Essentials Pack

Available in Classic World:

  • Convenience Essentials Pack
    • Price: 42,000 NX 9,900 NX

      • SP Reset Scroll
      • AP Reset Scroll

      • Safety Charm (10) (90-day duration)
      • Super Megaphone (10) (90-day duration)
    • Can be purchased once per account.
    • Can only be purchased with NX.
    • Both the package and its contents are untradable.

    • Can only be purchased with NX.

Pet Utility Items

Available in Classic World:

  • Water of Life
    • Price: 2,000 NX
    • Duration: 30 days
    • Can be used to extend the duration of a pet by 30 days, or brought to Mar the Fairy in Ellinia to restore a pet that has been turned into a doll, giving it a 30-day duration.
  • Pet Name Tag
    • Price: 1,800 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Used to name your pet.
    • Pets will respond much better if their name is called prior to making a command (ie: "Lucky, sit!").
  • Auto HP Potion Skill
    • Price: 2,500 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Allows your pet to use HP potions on you when your HP falls below the threshold that you set.
  • Auto MP Potion Skill
    • Price: 2,500 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Allows your pet to use MP potions on you when your MP falls below the threshold that you set.
  • Auto Move Skill
    • Price: 3,000 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Adds a skill that allows your pet to automatically pick up nearby items and mesos without having to move. Can be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.
  • Expanded Auto Move Skill
    • Price: 3,000 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Triples your pet's auto move distance. Can only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill.

AP and SP Reset Scrolls

Available in Classic World:

  • AP Reset Scroll
    • Price: 7,000 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Resets all stats, including AP invested in HP/MP.
    • Must be at least Lv. 10 to use.
  • SP Reset Scroll
    • Price: 7,000 NX
    • Duration: Permanent
    • Resets all skills, excluding Beginner skills.

    • Price (3): 1,050 NX 1,000 NX

  • Super Megaphone
    • Price (1): 1,500 NX
    • Price (3): 4,500 NX 4,300 NX
    • Price (12): 18,000 NX 13,200 NX

  • Item Megaphone
    • Price (1): 1,500 NX
    • Price (3): 4,500 NX 4,300 NX

Available in Classic World:

  • Storage Room 5-slot Coupon

  • Selective 5-slot Coupon
    • Price: 5,000 NX

    • If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.
